attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file North Carolina state corporate tax return. NC has the LOWEST state corporate income tax rate in the nation at 2.5%. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Physical presence includes office, employees, or property in NC. Economic nexus threshold: $100,000 gross receipts or 200 transactions. Reference: NC General Statute § 105-130.4 (Nexus and apportionment), NC Department of Revenue Directive CD-98-1 (Nexus standards).

condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true and apportionment.state_code is equal to "NC"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq apportionment.state_code NC streq and

condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true and apportionment.state_code is equal to "NC"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.state_code NC streq and

action_details.action_description: Log NC filing requirement due to physical presence
action_details.action_postfix: "NC filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). A corporation has physical presence nexus in NC if it has: office/store/warehouse, employees working in NC, tangible personal property in NC, or real property in NC. Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500. Reference: NC General Statute § 105-130.4 (Nexus and apportionment), NC Department of Revenue Directive CD-98-1 (Nexus standards)." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: Log NC filing requirement due to economic nexus
action_details.action_postfix: "NC filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Economic nexus threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in NC. Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), NC requires filing if corporation exceeds economic nexus thresholds, even without physical presence. Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), NC Department of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance, NC General Statute § 105-164.8 (Economic nexus provisions)." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: Set state tax to zero and refund any payments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_tax ! apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_refund_or_owed ! "No NC nexus - no filing requirement. Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. Any estimated payments refunded. Reference: NC General Statute § 105-130.4 (Nexus requirements)." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NC state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. NC ADDITIONS include: Interest on U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to NC), IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback (NC does not conform), State income taxes deducted on federal return, Bonus depreciation addback (varies by tax year), Expenses related to exempt income. NC SUBTRACTIONS include: Interest on NC state and municipal bonds, NC net operating loss deduction (subject to NC limitations), Dividend income eligible for NC dividend received deduction, Certain refunds of state income taxes. Reference: NC Form CD-405 Schedule A (Additions to Federal Taxable Income), NC Form CD-405 Schedule B (Deductions from Federal Taxable Income), NC General Statute § 105-130.5 (Adjustments to federal taxable income).

condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NC state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_description: Calculate NC state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /additions xdef 0.0 /subtractions xdef additions apportionment.state_additions ! subtractions apportionment.state_subtractions ! "NC state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. NC ADDITIONS: Interest income from U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to NC), IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback (NC does not conform), State income taxes deducted on federal return, Bonus depreciation addback (varies by tax year), Expenses related to exempt income. NC SUBTRACTIONS: Interest on NC state and municipal bonds, NC net operating loss deduction (subject to NC limitations), Dividend income eligible for NC dividend received deduction, Certain refunds of state income taxes. Reference: NC Form CD-405 Schedule A/B, NC General Statute § 105-130.5." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: Set state additions and subtractions to zero
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_additions ! 0.0 apportionment.state_subtractions ! "No NC nexus - no state adjustments calculated. Corporation does not have NC nexus, so no income adjustments are needed." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NC state corporate income tax. Applies NC 2.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. NC has the LOWEST state corporate tax rate in the nation at 2.5%. Process: (1) Federal taxable income apportioned to NC by table 7500, (2) Add NC-specific additions by table 51220, (3) Subtract NC-specific subtractions by table 51220, (4) Calculate NC state taxable income, (5) Apply NC 2.5% flat tax rate (LOWEST STATE RATE IN THE NATION), (6) Subtract NC state credits (Jobs creation, Film production, Renewable energy, Historic preservation, etc.), (7) Calculate refund or amount owed. NC uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor). NC tax rate history: 2025+ is 2.5% (lowest in nation), 2019-2024 varied from 2.5% to 6.9%, Before 2019 had progressive rates up to 6.9%. NC credits: Article 3J (Jobs creation), Article 3F (Film/entertainment production), Article 3B (Renewable energy), Article 3H (Historic rehabilitation). Reference: NC Form CD-405 (Corporation Income Tax Return), NC General Statute § 105-130.3 (Tax rate of 2.5%), NC General Statute § 105-130.4 (Single-sales apportionment), NC Department of Revenue Corporate Tax Bulletin 2025.

condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NC tax at 2.5% flat rate (LOWEST in nation)
action_details.action_description: Calculate NC state tax using 2.5% flat rate, apply credits, calculate refund or owed
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate mul /state_tax_before_credits xdef 0.0 state_tax_before_credits apportionment.state_credits sub max apportionment.state_tax ! apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub apportionment.state_refund_or_owed ! "NC state corporate income tax calculation: (1) Federal taxable income [Form 1120 line 28], (2) Apportioned to NC [× NC apportionment percentage], (3) NC additions [+ Federal interest, IRC 199A addback, etc.], (4) NC subtractions [- NC municipal interest, NC NOL, etc.], (5) NC taxable income = " apportionment.state_taxable_income cvs strconcat ", (6) NC tax rate × 2.5% (LOWEST STATE RATE IN THE NATION), (7) NC income tax before credits = " strconcat state_tax_before_credits cvs strconcat ", (8) NC credits - [Jobs, film, renewable energy, historic preservation, etc.] = " strconcat apportionment.state_credits cvs strconcat ", (9) NC tax liability = " strconcat apportionment.state_tax cvs strconcat ". NC uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor). Reference: NC Form CD-405, NC General Statute § 105-130.3 (Tax rate of 2.5%), NC General Statute § 105-130.4 (Single-sales apportionment), NC Department of Revenue Corporate Tax Bulletin 2025." strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: Set state tax to zero and refund any payments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_tax ! apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_refund_or_owed ! "No NC nexus - no tax liability. Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in NC. Any estimated payments are refunded. Reference: NC General Statute § 105-130.4 (Nexus requirements)." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_description: Set state tax to zero and refund any payments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_tax ! apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_refund_or_owed ! "No NC taxable income - no tax liability. Corporation has NC nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment and adjustments. Any estimated payments are refunded. NC net operating loss (NOL) rules may apply: NC allows NOL carryforward for 15 years, No carryback allowed (as of 2025), NOL limited to 80% of taxable income (similar to federal). Reference: NC Form CD-405 (Corporation Income Tax Return), NC General Statute § 105-130.8 (Net operating loss deduction)." job.audit_trail swap addto
